newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel lifts siege of Ramallah, Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Israel lifts siege of Ramallah, Hebron.

text.p: The Israeli army said on Thursday it had lifted its siege of the Palestinian West Bank towns of Hebron and Ramallah but that the area surrounding Jerusalem and the town of Bethlehem remained sealed off.
"From this morning the internal closure was lifted from Hebron and Ramallah," an army spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said the general ban against Palestinians from the West Bank and the Gaza Strip entering Israel remained in place.

Israel sealed off the West Bank and Gaza Strip and restricted the some two million Palestinians there to their towns and villages after a July 30 twin suicide bombing at an Israeli market killed 16 people, including the two attackers.

The bombing plunged relations between Israel and the Palestinians to a new low. Israel suspended resumption of substantive peace talks with the Palestinians and withheld financial transfers it owed the Palestinian Authority.

Palestinians say the moves amount to collective punishment. Israel has gradually eased the "internal closure" but the other measures remain in place. Jordan's King Hussein failed on Wednesday to persuade Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to ease the measures.
